description_en: Retrieves the details of a report delivery configuration
description_zh: 获取报告发送配置明细信息
name: DescribeCustomizeReportConfigDetail

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the access source
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The report ID.\
The ReportId returned by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/271655.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
报告ID。\
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/271655.html接口返回参数中的ReportId
parameters.name: report_id

parameters.help_en:
The language type. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言类型，默认值zh。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

ChartIds.description_en: The report chart configuration IDs, separated by commas
ChartIds.description_zh: 报告图表配置ID，多项用逗号分隔

GroupType.description_en:
The group type. Valid values:
ALIYUN_RG: ALIYUN_RG.
SAS_GROUP: SAS_GROUP
GroupType.description_zh:
分组类型，取值：
ALIYUN_RG：ALIYUN_RG。
SAS_GROUP：SAS_GROUP

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the report is a default report. Valid values:
0: Not a default report.
1: A default report
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认报告。取值：
0：非默认报告。
1：默认报告

MemberAccountSyncFlag.description_en:
Specifies whether newly added accounts are included by default. Valid values:

true: Included.
false: Not included.
Only version 2.0.0 supports this parameter
MemberAccountSyncFlag.description_zh:
新增账号默认是否接入。取值：

true：是。
false：否。
仅2.0.0版本支持

Recipients.description_en: The recipient email addresses, separated by commas
Recipients.description_zh: 联系人邮箱，多个用英文逗号分割

ReportDays.description_en: The number of recent days covered by the report statistics

ReportEndDate.description_en: The end date for report delivery

ReportLang.description_en:
The language type. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
ReportLang.description_zh:
语言类型，默认值zh。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文

ReportSendType.description_en:
The report delivery time range. Valid values:
1: 0:00 to 6:00.
2: 6:00 to 12:00.
3: 12:00 to 18:00.
4: 18:00 to 24:00

ReportStartDate.description_en: The start date for report delivery

ReportStatus.description_en:
The report status. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
ReportStatus.description_zh:
报告状态。取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启

ReportType.description_en:
The report type. Valid values:

0: Daily report.
1: Weekly report.
2: Monthly report.
3: Custom period
ReportType.description_zh:
报告类型。取值：

0：日报。
1：周报。
2：月报。
3：自定义周期

SendEndTime.description_en: The delivery end time, in the format of HH:mm:ss

SendPeriodDays.description_en: The specific execution dates within the delivery period
SendPeriodDays.description_zh: 发送周期内具体执行日期

SendPeriodType.description_en:
The delivery period type. Valid values:
DAY: day.
WEEK: week.
MONTH: month
SendPeriodType.description_zh:
发送周期类型，取值：
DAY：天。
WEEK：周。
MONTH：月

SendStartTime.description_en: The delivery start time, in the format of HH:mm:ss

SendTime.description_en: The delivery time, in the format of HH:mm:ss

TargetUids.description_en: The list of target UIDs, separated by commas
TargetUids.description_zh: 目标uid列表，多项用逗号分隔
